title: Audio output level indicator relies on undocumented/nonstandard features and thus only works for Breeze theme
line: The live audio level in the volume sliders is now visible with every Plasma theme, not just Breeze.
explanation: The applet drew the live level as a second widgets/slider groove-highlight with status Selected. Selected only swaps the SVG's color stylesheet, and only Breeze's groove-highlight uses ButtonBackground under a half-transparent highlight, so in Oxygen and almost every third-party theme both frames looked the same and the level was invisible. The applet now draws the level with a new optional groove-meter element (prefix list groove-meter, groove-highlight); Breeze gets that element with its exact current look. Themes without it get a theme-independent fallback: the level in full groove-highlight over the rest of the highlight at 50% opacity.

commits.message:
applet: show the audio meter with any Plasma theme

The live audio level was drawn as a selected groove-highlight, which only
Breeze styles differently, so other themes showed no level at all. Use a
groove-meter element when the theme has one, or else fade the highlight.

BUG: 463953

desktoptheme/breeze: add a groove-meter element to the slider

The volume applet drew its audio meter as a selected groove-highlight to
get a solid highlight fill in Breeze. Add a dedicated groove-meter frame
with that look so the applet can use it instead of the selected state.

BUG: 463953

From af67d2676fe6c35e95c9a267a9eb18c5e9a26a54 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 18:24:21 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applet: show the audio meter with any Plasma theme

The live audio level was drawn as a selected groove-highlight, which only
Breeze styles differently, so other themes showed no level at all. Use a
groove-meter element when the theme has one, or else fade the highlight.

BUG: 463953
---
 applet/VolumeSlider.qml | 7 +++++--
 1 file changed, 5 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applet/VolumeSlider.qml b/applet/VolumeSlider.qml
index 5f365ccb..84cbe895 100644
--- a/applet/VolumeSlider.qml
+++ b/applet/VolumeSlider.qml
@@ -107,6 +107,9 @@ PC3.Slider {
         KSvg.FrameSvgItem {
             imagePath: "widgets/slider"
             prefix: "groove-highlight"
+            // Themes without a groove-meter element get the meter as a
+            // full-opacity highlight over a faded one
+            opacity: control.showVolumeIndicator && meter.available && meterFill.usedPrefix !== "groove-meter" ? 0.5 : 1
 
             anchors.left: parent.left
             anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
@@ -117,9 +120,9 @@ PC3.Slider {
         }
 
         KSvg.FrameSvgItem {
+            id: meterFill
             imagePath: "widgets/slider"
-            prefix: "groove-highlight"
-            status: KSvg.FrameSvgItem.Selected
+            prefix: ["groove-meter", "groove-highlight"]
             visible: control.showVolumeIndicator && meter.available && control.volume > 0
 
             anchors.left: parent.left
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Before, tone playing: Breeze (top) shows the level as a darker fill; Oxygen (bottom) is filled uniformly, level only a faint seam
After, same tone: Breeze (top) unchanged pixel for pixel; Oxygen (bottom) now shows the level as a bright fill over a faded highlight
After, Oxygen, Devices tab: device meter visible while playing (left); silent (right) the highlight stays faded up to the handle

review.text: The design is sound and pragmatic: adding an optional groove-meter SVG prefix to widgets/slider preserves Breeze pixel-for-pixel while giving third-party theme authors a semantic element, and the 50% opacity groove-highlight fallback in VolumeSlider.qml makes the live meter immediately visible across all existing themes such as Oxygen. The plasma-pa QML diff is clean and well-verified visually. However, both the libplasma and plasma-pa commits carry BUG: 463953, so merging the libplasma prerequisite first would prematurely close the bug before the plasma-pa fix lands, and because the Breeze SVG diff is binary, Breeze Dark and custom accent colors should also be verified to ensure groove-meter uses ColorScheme-Highlight styling.
changes: Change BUG: 463953 to CCBUG: 463953 in the libplasma commit (keeping BUG: 463953 on the plasma-pa commit) so merging the theme asset change first does not prematurely close the bug.

Verify the new groove-meter element in libplasma's breeze/widgets/slider.svg with Breeze Dark and a non-default accent color to confirm it uses ColorScheme-Highlight CSS styling rather than a hardcoded color.

reviews.text: This replaces the meaningless Selected-state trick with an optional groove-meter element (FrameSvgItem prefix list plus usedPrefix, both standard KSvg API). Themes without it get a fallback that works everywhere: full highlight over a 50% highlight. The screenshots show Breeze unchanged and Oxygen's level now clearly visible, both on the Applications and Devices tabs. Breeze-derived third-party themes that copied the Selected styling will switch to the fallback look, but the level stays visible. Nits: the libplasma commit could use CCBUG so the bug does not close before the applet change lands, and groove-meter should be added to the theme element reference on develop.kde.org so the new element isn't undocumented too.
